decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the established consumer health offer and was earlier presented on its own page, so management stays committed despite the lack of recent evidence and attributes any weakness to temporary market conditions.
The skin and hair supplement was publicly launched as new in pharmacies and fits the announced consumer health expansion, so having already justified it, management persists with it.
As part of the visible Trivital line extension, the joint supplement embodies the firm's public commitment to the brand, which argues for keeping it.

The OTC triptan required substantial regulatory and development investment and is central to the announced broadening into consumer health, so the missing web evidence is read as temporary and the firm keeps it.
